label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
body: This is the total revenue a business expects to earn from a single customer throughout their entire relationship with your brand.
caption:
Understanding your Customer Lifetime Value helps you see the long-term benefit of each customer. Instead of just focusing on the first sale, you start thinking about how to keep customers happy so they buy from you again and again. For instance, if a customer buys a $20 digital product but then buys two more products over the year and enrolls in a $50 workshop next year, their CLV is at least $110
